sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Energy Master is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Every AP gain is increased by 1.

sections.title: How to Get Energy Master
sections.content: Location: Defeat Serpenphare on The Continent - requires Esquie's flight.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
